name: Structured Latent Codes Anchored to Mesh
definition: Geometry ($l_{geo}$) and appearance ($l_{rgb}$) latent codes stored at anchor nodes (mesh vertices) on a deformable mesh, allowing local editing and deformation tracking.
summary: Structured Latent Codes Anchored to Mesh ties latent features to mesh vertices for local editing, distinguishing itself from implicit methods by tracking vertex movements and from surfel methods via continuous interpolation.
